items.title: Investing in the public benefit
items.summary: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.306
items.summary:
- Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables
- Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

items.title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
items.summary: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. In this post, we preview data we’ve collected from applying attack surface reduction techniques to large open-source codebases using Claude.

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset

items.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
items.summary: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.

items.title: Evaluating discrimination in language model decisions
items.summary: We evaluate discrimination in Claude across 70 decision scenarios and show prompt-based interventions can significantly reduce it.

items.title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
items.summary: A randomized trial with 52 developers found AI assistance lowered comprehension scores, except when used for explanations rather than delegation.

items.title: A small number of samples can poison LLMs
items.summary: Anthropic research on data poisoning attacks shows a few hundred malicious documents can "backdoor" large language models of any size.

items.summary: A report describing a highly sophisticated AI-led cyberattack and how we disrupted it.

items.summary: Government red-teamers tested Constitutional Classifiers on Claude Opus 4 and 4.1, uncovering vulnerabilities that strengthened our safeguards.

items.title: Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation
items.summary: We’re partnering with Accenture on independent evaluation of frontier AI—part of our recent commitment to embed evaluators at Anthropic. Both we and Accenture expect to invest at least $1 billion to build capacity in this area over the next five years.

items.summary:

- Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all

- Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.295
items.summary:
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
- Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done
- Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without…

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.294
items.summary:
- Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block
- Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early

- Added `agentType` to the `subagentStatusLine` payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart
